name: Bergwelt
beschreibung: The stylish Hotel Bergwelt enjoys a prime central location in St. Anton am Arlberg, just moments from the mountain cable cars and vibrant pedestrian centre. The property seamlessly blends alpine tradition with sleek, contemporary interior design. Guests can indulge in authentic regional specialities at the on-site restaurant, unwind in the relaxing sauna area, and recharge in comfortable rooms boasting panoramic mountain views. The railway station is also conveniently situated just a short walk away.
